info.name: O2C Timesheet Module (ORDS)
info.description:
O2C Timesheet Module - the ORDS surface.

Generated from services/oc_time/openapi3.json, so no request can point at a path that is not deployed. Regenerate with postman/build_collection.py.

START HERE: run "1. Auth" -> "login". Its test script stores the token and the signed-in employee id as collection variables; every other request reads them from there.

periodId, projectId and tsWeekId start empty. The GET requests that list them (getPeriods, getManagerProjects, getWeeks) tell you what to fill in.

Sign in as a different persona by changing the email collection variable:
  admin@rite.digital              ROLE_TIME_ADMIN   (no worker row)
  navamani.solairajan@rite.digital ROLE_TIME_MANAGER RI9001
  sampaul.jeevan@rite.digital     ROLE_TIME_EMPLOYEE RI2824
All seeded with password Rite@123 (test data only).

request.description: Sign in. Returns a 64-hex bearer token valid 24 hours, plus the role resolved by V_OC_TIME_SIGNIN. Unknown email and wrong password deliberately return the same 401.

exec: console.log('token saved -', r.role, r.employeeId || '(no worker row)');

request.description: Resolve a token to an identity. An unknown or expired token returns 200 with an empty items array, not an error.
End a session. 200 whether or not the token existed - an already-dead session is a successful logout to the caller.
